definitions.explanation: The temperature of the body, typically measured to check for fever or illness.

examples.japanese: {体温|たいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

examples.english: My temperature is as high as 38 degrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{体温|たいおん}⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a temperature check before entering the hospital.

notes:
{体温|たいおん} refers to the temperature of a living body. Compound of ⟦{体|たい}→体：09872_tai⟧ (body) + {温|おん} (temperature).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {体温|たいおん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to take one's temperature
- {体温|たいおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: temperature rises
- {体温|たいおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: temperature drops
- {体温|たいおん}⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧: temperature check

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧: thermometer (body temperature)
- ⟦{低体温|ていたいおん}→低体温：26320_teitaion⟧: hypothermia
- ⟦{平熱|へいねつ}→平熱：15477_heinetsu⟧: normal body temperature

CULTURAL NOTE:
Normal body temperature in Japan is typically considered around 36-37°C. Japan uses Celsius exclusively. Temperature checks became ubiquitous at building entrances during health screening periods.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧: fever / heat
- ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧: air temperature (weather)
